How it began

Our Story

🌿
Several years ago…

Where it all began ✨

It started with mutual friends, an easy laugh, and the quiet feeling that this might just be something special. Two young souls, completely unaware that a simple introduction would set their whole story in motion.

The early days ☕

Every café. Every dish.

Their love story was written across menus and table corners across Bengaluru. Café by café, dish by dish — they were on a mission. If gluttony was a sin, they were gloriously unrepentant.

The glow-up 🤭

A true sign of love 🤭

From two skinny kids to two people radiating pure joy — they grew together in every sense. Scientists confirm: shared meals, shared laughter, and a whole lot of love leads to this. A true sign.

Adventures 🌍

The world, together

A stroll by the beach, the crisp air of the Himalayas, through jungle paths and bustling city streets — their adventures wrote chapters that no book could quite capture. Every new place, a new memory.

The conversations 🌙

"When we get married…"

Through a million late nights, city lights, and conversations that stretched into the early hours, they talked endlessly about the life they'd build together. Those "someday" dreams? They're finally here.

October 24, 2026 💛

Here we are.

From two people who had no idea what was coming, to a couple who built something real, warm, and entirely their own — Jitesh and Utthami are ready for their greatest adventure yet. And they'd love nothing more than to celebrate it with you.
